/bin/bash -lc "find app components lib pages -maxdepth 5 -type f -print 2>/dev/null | sort; git status --short; sed -n '1,260p' app/blog/'[id]'/page.tsx; sed -n '1,280p' app/api/posts/'[id]'/route.ts"

/bin/bash -lc 'find pages -depth -type d -empty -delete 2>/dev/null || true
[ ! -e pages ] && echo '"'pages directory removed'
npx next typegen"
/bin/bash -lc 'npx tsc --noEmit'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm start'

/bin/bash -lc 'set -e
for route in / /blog /blog/1 /does-not-exist /api/posts /api/posts/7; do
  code=$(curl -sS -o /tmp/codex-route-body -w '"'%{http_code}' \"http://127.0.0.1:3000"'$route")
  title=$(rg -o '"'<title>["'^<]*'"' /tmp/codex-route-body | head -1 || true)
  echo \""'$route $code $title"
done
curl -sS -X POST -H '"'content-type: application/json' -d '{\"title\":\"New\",\"content\":\"Body\"}' -D - http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/posts -o /tmp/codex-post-body | sed -n '1,8p'
sed -n '1,2p' /tmp/codex-post-body
curl -sS -X PUT -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{\"title\":\"Changed\"}' -D - http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/posts/7 -o /tmp/codex-put-body | sed -n '1,8p'
sed -n '1,2p' /tmp/codex-put-body
curl -sS -X DELETE -D - http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/posts/7 -o /tmp/codex-delete-body | sed -n '1,8p'
sed -n '1,2p' /tmp/codex-delete-body
curl -sS -X PATCH -D - http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/posts -o /tmp/codex-patch-body | sed -n '1,12p'
sed -n '1,2p' /tmp/codex-patch-body
curl -sS -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{}' -D - http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/posts -o /tmp/codex-invalid-body | sed -n '1,8p'
sed -n '1,2p' /tmp/codex-invalid-body"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' tsconfig.json; rg -n \"from ['\\\"]next/(router|head|document)|get(ServerSide|Static|Initial)|NextApi|useRouter|<Head|pages/\" -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!**/.next/**'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' . || true; test "'! -e pages && echo '"'pages absent'; find app components lib -type f -print | sort; git diff --stat; git diff --check; git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc 'git show HEAD:tsconfig.json; git show HEAD:.gitignore; git check-ignore -v .next tsconfig.tsbuildinfo next-env.d.ts || true; git ls-tree --name-only HEAD next-env.d.ts package-lock.json AGENTS.md'

/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- .gitignore tsconfig.json package.json styles/globals.css; for file in $(find app components lib -type f | sort); do echo "--- $file"; sed -n '"'1,280p' \""'$file"; done'

/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- package.json | sed -n '1,160p'; git diff -- tsconfig.json; git diff --check; npx tsc --noEmit"

/bin/bash -lc 'npx tsc --noEmit && git diff --check && test ! -e pages && if rg -n "from ['"'\\\"]next/(router|head|document)|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|getInitialProps|NextApi\" app components lib styles next.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json; then exit 1; fi
git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build
status=$?
if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$status"; fi
if rg -n "from ['"'\\\"]next/(router|head|document)['\\\"]|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|getInitialProps|NextApi\" app components lib styles next.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json; then exit 1; fi

git status --short'
